decision: Evidence supports a separately registered finite controlled test that supplies raw one-step successor states only to temperature learning while retaining32-step critic targets, current actor states, original replay sampling and all other settings. No candidate adapter, optimizer test or formal deployment is complete in this run.
scope: Frozen14, one fixed8192-row cohort and common action-noise seed, diagnostic highest FP32 only; no claim of actual Adam step direction or improved task success. Higher precision is local to diagnostics, not deployed. Original32-step gamma bootstrap is correct and must not be changed.
